string.name: permission_reason_bluetooth
string.value: Bluetooth is used to discover, connect to and exchange data with nearby devices.

string.name: permission_reason_location
string.value: Approximate location is used to turn coordinates into addresses and to search nearby places.

string.name: permission_reason_clipboard
string.value: Clipboard content is read only when the app explicitly asks for it.

string.name: permission_reason_contacts
string.value: Contacts are looked up to fill in the names and phone numbers the app asks for.

string.name: permission_reason_calendar_read
string.value: Calendar events are read to show the schedule the app requests.

string.name: permission_reason_calendar_write
string.value: Calendar events are created when the app adds an event.

string.name: permission_reason_print
string.value: Documents the app renders can be sent to the system print service.

string.name: permission_reason_internet
string.value: Internet access is used when the app loads network content or calls web services.
